headline: Council accepted $500,000 and $1,000,000 in EPA brownfields funds, adopted 2027-2031 CDBG priorities, and referred a Median Strip Ordinance to committee 7-1.
summary: The Council approved several liquor and entertainment license orders, accepted EPA brownfields grants, and adopted Community Development Block Grant priorities for 2027-2031. It referred a Median Strip Ordinance to the Sustainability and Transportation Committee and postponed a restaurant license order to October 5, 2026. Several other items, including a Council Rules resolve and two funding orders, had first readings only.
decisions: Approved the Special City Council Meeting Minutes from 09.09.2026, 8-0.
Passed Order 40-26/27 declaring October 4, 2026 the 35th Annual Maine Marathon, Half Marathon & Relay Festival, along with Orders 41 and 42, as consent items, 8-0.
Postponed Order 43-26/27, granting approval for Chez Mere Jos African Restaurant LLC, dba Chez Biso, at 11 Brown Street, to the October 5, 2026 meeting.
Approved Order 38-26/27, accepting and appropriating $500,000 from the EPA for Brownfields Assessment, 8-0.
Approved Order 39-26/27, accepting and appropriating $1,000,000 for Brownfields Cleanup, 8-0.
Adopted Order 44-26/27, the 2026 CDBG Priority Setting Task Force Recommendations and the 2027-2031 Housing and Urban Development 5-Year Consolidated Plan priorities, 8-0.
Referred Order 45-26/27, a Median Strip Ordinance, to the Sustainability and Transportation Committee, 7-1 with Councilor Pelletier opposed.
